name: Agrippa the Wayfinder
description: A marooned sailor who learns to manipulate sea dragons with fire.

description_citations.text: "The Dragons of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Agrippa learns to manipulate the island's sea dragons with fire and escapes with gold to clear his great-grandfather's name.
timeline.quote: He builds a boat in secret and then escapes with some of the gold from the beach
